title: Transport checks in AutoDiag (shared memory, intra-process)
keywords: autodiag transport shared memory shm dds_shm intra_process udp tcp --transport dev shm ipc container
text: Tell AutoDiag which transport you expect with --transport (auto, intra_process, dds_shm, dds_udp or dds_tcp) or the dashboard Transport tab; that enables mode-specific rules. For shared memory it inspects /dev/shm, free space and the IPC namespace, for example dds-autodiag check --transport dds_shm, or compare two container snapshots with --transport dds_shm. AutoDiag says explicitly that it cannot see which transport DDS selected at runtime.
